description: Estimate the CRS points an Express Entry candidate gains on November 3, 2026, when Canadian work experience becomes the Labour Market Integration factor: unchanged work-length points plus 70/40/20 extra points after 12+ months in a 2×/1.5×/1.3× high-wage occupation, or 100/70/50 points for a job offer in one (no LMIA needed), whichever is higher, never both. Max 150 (140 with a spouse). Give NOC codes; the tool looks up each occupation's level on IRCC's list. Only this factor changes.

canadian_work_years.description: Years of skilled (TEER 0–3) work in Canada in the last 10 years, as counted today; 5 means 5 or more

current_crs_score.description: CRS score in the profile today (optional)

high_wage_jobs.description: Canadian jobs (part of that work experience) and the months spent in each. Omit if none.

job_offer_noc_code.description: NOC code of a qualifying full-time job offer, if any

spouse_counted.description: True if a spouse or common-law partner is coming to Canada and isn't a citizen or PR

name: calculate_crs_november_2026
title: New CRS points (November 3, 2026)
